I added `GET /api/admin/users/recently-created`, which returns the logins of users created in the last 7 days. I didn't run the build or any tests, as you asked, so none of this is compiled or tested.

- **Repository:** `UserRepository` has a new derived query, `findAllByCreatedDateAfter(Instant)`. The caller computes the cutoff, as `docs/persistence.md` requires.
- **Service:** `UserService.getRecentlyCreatedUserLogins()` runs read-only and computes the cutoff as `Instant.now(clock).minus(7, DAYS)`.
- **Resource:** `UserResource.getRecentlyCreatedUsers()` is admin-only with `@PreAuthorize`, like the other methods in that class. I put it above `/users/{login}` so the two paths stay clearly separate.
- **Clock bean:** `src/main/java/CLAUDE.md` requires an injected `java.time.Clock`, and the project had none. I added `ClockConfiguration` with a `Clock.systemUTC()` bean. `UserService` now takes a `Clock` as a fifth constructor argument.

- **Unbounded list:** `docs/backend.md` says REST endpoints shouldn't return unbounded lists. I kept your spec of a plain list of logins, but the result grows with signups. Say so if you want it paged.
- **Index:** `docs/persistence.md` asks for an index on new query patterns. I didn't add a Liquibase changelog for `created_date`.

I didn't add tests.
